item.title: Check now: CVE-2026-126187: React Server Components Flaw Lets Attackers Execute Code Through Smuggled Flight Rows
item.description:
Supply chain: CVE-2026-126187: React Server Components Flaw Lets Attackers Execute Code Through Smuggled Flight Rows.

First step: Check whether you use this package, extension or tool, and which version. If you installed an affected version: remove it, and rotate every credential and token that machine or pipeline could reach.

React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
